relations.subject: Kazuyoshi Kino
relations.evidence: Together with Hajime Nakamura and others, he translated the Heart Sutra, the Prajnaparamita sutras, and the three main sutras of the Jodo sect.

relations.evidence: While he was a second year student at the School of Indian Philosophy, Literature Department, Imperial University of Tokyo, he was drafted... He was repatriated in 1946, resumed his studies and graduated in 1948.
